categories.sqliteDDL: CREATE TABLE categories (category_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, category_name TEXT NOT NULL)

products.sqliteDDL: CREATE TABLE products (product_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, category_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES categories(category_id), product_name TEXT NOT NULL, list_price_cents INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(list_price_cents>=0), reorder_level INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(reorder_level>=0), active INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(active IN (0,1)))
products.mysqlDDL:
CREATE TABLE products (
  product_id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY,
  category_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
  product_name VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL,
  list_price_cents BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK(list_price_cents>=0),
  reorder_level INT NOT NULL CHECK(reorder_level>=0),
  active INT NOT NULL CHECK(active IN (0,1)),
  FOREIGN KEY (category_id) REFERENCES categories(category_id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_bin;

suppliers.sqliteDDL: CREATE TABLE suppliers (supplier_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, supplier_name TEXT NOT NULL, region TEXT NOT NULL)

warehouses.sqliteDDL: CREATE TABLE warehouses (warehouse_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, warehouse_name TEXT NOT NULL)

supplier_contracts.sqliteDDL: CREATE TABLE supplier_contracts (contract_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, supplier_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES suppliers(supplier_id), product_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES products(product_id), start_date TEXT NOT NULL, end_date TEXT NOT NULL, unit_price_cents INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(unit_price_cents>=0), UNIQUE(supplier_id,product_id,start_date))
supplier_contracts.mysqlDDL:
CREATE TABLE supplier_contracts (
  contract_id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY,
  supplier_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
  product_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
  start_date DATE NOT NULL,
  end_date DATE NOT NULL,
  unit_price_cents BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK(unit_price_cents>=0),
  UNIQUE(supplier_id,product_id,start_date),
  FOREIGN KEY (supplier_id) REFERENCES suppliers(supplier_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (product_id) REFERENCES products(product_id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_bin;

columns.name: status
columns.description: 业务状态（见表约束及口径）

purchase_orders.sqliteDDL: CREATE TABLE purchase_orders (po_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, supplier_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES suppliers(supplier_id), warehouse_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES warehouses(warehouse_id), order_date TEXT NOT NULL, promised_date TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('placed','cancelled','closed')))
purchase_orders.mysqlDDL:
CREATE TABLE purchase_orders (
  po_id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY,
  supplier_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
  warehouse_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
  order_date DATE NOT NULL,
  promised_date DATE NOT NULL,
  status VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('placed','cancelled','closed')),
  FOREIGN KEY (supplier_id) REFERENCES suppliers(supplier_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (warehouse_id) REFERENCES warehouses(warehouse_id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_bin;

purchase_order_items.sqliteDDL: CREATE TABLE purchase_order_items (po_item_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, po_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES purchase_orders(po_id), product_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES products(product_id), contract_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES supplier_contracts(contract_id), quantity_ordered INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(quantity_ordered>0), unit_price_cents INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(unit_price_cents>=0))
purchase_order_items.mysqlDDL:
CREATE TABLE purchase_order_items (
  po_item_id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY,
  po_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
  product_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
  contract_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
  quantity_ordered INT NOT NULL CHECK(quantity_ordered>0),
  unit_price_cents BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK(unit_price_cents>=0),
  FOREIGN KEY (po_id) REFERENCES purchase_orders(po_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (product_id) REFERENCES products(product_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (contract_id) REFERENCES supplier_contracts(contract_id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_bin;

goods_receipts.sqliteDDL: CREATE TABLE goods_receipts (receipt_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, po_item_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES purchase_order_items(po_item_id), receipt_date TEXT NOT NULL, quantity_received INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(quantity_received>0), quantity_rejected INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(quantity_rejected>=0), CHECK(quantity_rejected<=quantity_received))
goods_receipts.mysqlDDL:
CREATE TABLE goods_receipts (
  receipt_id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY,
  po_item_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
  receipt_date DATE NOT NULL,
  quantity_received INT NOT NULL CHECK(quantity_received>0),
  quantity_rejected INT NOT NULL CHECK(quantity_rejected>=0),
  CHECK(quantity_rejected<=quantity_received),
  FOREIGN KEY (po_item_id) REFERENCES purchase_order_items(po_item_id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_bin;

columns.name: invoice_no
columns.description: 供应商发票业务编号（可重复异常）

supplier_invoices.sqliteDDL: CREATE TABLE supplier_invoices (supplier_invoice_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, po_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES purchase_orders(po_id), invoice_no TEXT NOT NULL, invoice_date TEXT NOT NULL, due_date TEXT NOT NULL)
supplier_invoices.mysqlDDL:
CREATE TABLE supplier_invoices (
  supplier_invoice_id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY,
  po_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
  invoice_no VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL,
  invoice_date DATE NOT NULL,
  due_date DATE NOT NULL,
  FOREIGN KEY (po_id) REFERENCES purchase_orders(po_id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_bin;

supplier_invoice_items.sqliteDDL: CREATE TABLE supplier_invoice_items (supplier_invoice_item_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, supplier_invoice_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES supplier_invoices(supplier_invoice_id), po_item_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES purchase_order_items(po_item_id), quantity_billed INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(quantity_billed>0), unit_price_cents INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(unit_price_cents>=0))
supplier_invoice_items.mysqlDDL:
CREATE TABLE supplier_invoice_items (
  supplier_invoice_item_id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY,
  supplier_invoice_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
  po_item_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
  quantity_billed INT NOT NULL CHECK(quantity_billed>0),
  unit_price_cents BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK(unit_price_cents>=0),
  FOREIGN KEY (supplier_invoice_id) REFERENCES supplier_invoices(supplier_invoice_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (po_item_id) REFERENCES purchase_order_items(po_item_id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_bin;

views.v_po_lines: CREATE VIEW v_po_lines AS SELECT i.po_item_id,i.po_id,p.supplier_id,p.warehouse_id,p.order_date,p.promised_date,i.product_id,i.quantity_ordered,i.unit_price_cents,i.quantity_ordered*i.unit_price_cents AS ordered_cents,COALESCE(r.received,0) received,COALESCE(r.accepted,0) accepted,COALESCE(r.on_time,0) on_time,COALESCE(b.billed,0) billed,COALESCE(b.billed_cents,0) billed_cents FROM purchase_order_items i JOIN purchase_orders p ON p.po_id=i.po_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT g.po_item_id,SUM(g.quantity_received) received,SUM(g.quantity_received-g.quantity_rejected) accepted,SUM(CASE WHEN g.receipt_date<=p.promised_date THEN g.quantity_received-g.quantity_rejected ELSE 0 END) on_time FROM goods_receipts g JOIN purchase_order_items i ON i.po_item_id=g.po_item_id JOIN purchase_orders p ON p.po_id=i.po_id WHERE g.receipt_date<='2025-12-31' GROUP BY g.po_item_id) r ON r.po_item_id=i.po_item_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT po_item_id,SUM(quantity_billed) billed,SUM(quantity_billed*unit_price_cents) billed_cents FROM supplier_invoice_items GROUP BY po_item_id) b ON b.po_item_id=i.po_item_id WHERE p.status<>'cancelled'
